status: Merged diagnostic cycle, forced rebuilt and full-output verified. No production storage optimization or speedup claim.
methodology: Five warmups and twenty complete 1024-chunk lit regions per case. Every original ColumnState::material lookup computes the original RLE value before the test hook. Per-thread counters report storage-kind weights and run lengths; a joined scan counts live owners and backing slices without initializing or retaining them. Entire observer and hooks are excluded from ordinary builds. Separate ordinary-library corpus uses shader-ready policy. Complete decompressed NBT and region membership are compared; only MCA timestamps/compression representation are excluded.

finding: 18.03–31.18 million ColumnState material reads per region. Shared terrain carries 59.7–62.0%, Owned runs 25.2–28.6%, Cached archives 9.4–13.5%. A Shared-only full-height dense copy would add mean 162.7–183.3 MB of voxel payload per live region before new object/allocator overhead, while retaining original RLE. Cached distinct-slice sharing alone has modest payload potential; unique-state counts are only 5–15% above distinct slices. Joined state is not transient or engine-wide peak memory.

next_opportunity.candidate: Evaluate a compact immutable run-boundary rank index, with exact RLE fallback for layouts outside its representable range, before paying the much larger dense-column payload. Derive it only from the original runs; preserve RLE, heights, archive format, owners, source ordering and synchronous retirement. Verify every boundary and wrapped/out-of-range material query, full output and whole-region/concurrent behavior.
next_opportunity.uncertainty: Additional metadata and construction can erase lookup savings. Read-call shares are not wall-time shares. A compact index is a hypothesis, not a measured improvement.
